name: ENTEGA Medianet
aka: formerly known as HEAG MediaNet GmbH (1996-2011) and HSE Medianet GmbH (2011-2016)
notes:
We have a selective but generally open peering policy and evaluate each request based on its value for our network.

Peering through route servers is usually preferred over direct BGP sessions, especially for low-volume, low-prefix peers that already use the route servers.
This is to avoid unnecessary maintenance and configuration overhead.
For direct BGP sessions we require a significant amount of traffic coming from or destined to your network.

Also an up-to-date PeeringDB entry is required for all public peering requests.

PNIs are preferred for peers with 95/5 > 3 Gbps.

* We filter all our customers with strict prefix-lists, no exceptions.
* We filter RPKI invalids on all sessions.
* We filter TIER1 ASNs in path on all peering + customer sessions.
* We do not accept prefixes smaller than /24 (IPv4) or /48 (IPv6).

Additional BCP filtering as strictly as possible and other security measures are implied.

Please review your registered ROAs to reduce number of invalid prefixes.
